_comment: Axis-3: NBA game winners (moneylines). Adam-7's structure in points of margin -- market price is the anchor, the model forecasts only the deviation. PAPER, HIDDEN. Data from ESPN's public API (src/ingest/espnNba.js). Created 2026-11-01.
_comment_hidden: Off every public surface (GET /api/bots, copy subscribe, model alerts) while it paper trades. Flip to false and deploy the backend to show it.
description: A proprietary BlockPools prediction model for NBA game markets. It prices each game in the last two hours before tip-off -- injuries and late scratches first, then form, rest and travel -- and trades only where the market has not caught up.

reporting._comment: NBA plays every day, so ROI and selectivity are reported per Monday-Sunday week (US-Eastern), not per NFL week.

model._comment: UNCALIBRATED: weights follow the user's order of importance (injury > momentum > rest/travel > primetime > style), not a fit -- there is no NBA closing-line history yet. Every factor is in POINTS OF HOME MARGIN; points sum, then convert to a probability once through sigmaMarginPts.

injury._comment: Counts CHANGES the market may not have absorbed: impact x (availability now - availability over the last recentGames) x freshness. freshnessHalfLifeHours=2: a status that changed 2h ago counts half, 6h ago an eighth -- the line has moved on it by then. A player out for weeks counts nothing (he was out lately too). returnFreshness is the share credited to a player BACK after missing games, whose return time ESPN does not stamp.

statusMultiplier._comment: Probability he SITS. ESPN's fantasy status: OUT, OFS (out for season), GTD (game-time decision). The others are the NBA report's own words, kept in case ESPN surfaces them.

momentum._comment: Win streaks plus recent margin (exp-weighted, halfLifeGames) against season margin, current season only. shrinkGames damps the early season, when 'recent' and 'season' are the same handful of games.

rest._comment: Second night of a back-to-back is the big one (~2 pts). Travel from the previous game's arena; eastward time zones only bite on a back-to-back.

primetime._comment: ESPN / ABC / NBC / Prime / TNT national games (NBA TV excluded): the better team (by season margin) gets betterTeamPts, the home side homeCrowdPts.

style._comment: Variance, not quality: factor = sqrt(poss/league) / (1 + k x (3PA rate - league)); points = implied margin x (factor - 1). Fast inside games favour the favourite, slow three-point games the underdog.

risk._comment_rounds: NBA recycles the book most days of the week (configs/risk note in config.json): 5, not NFL's 1.

policy._comment: Adam-7's exits and sizing. Prices from priceWindowHoursBeforeTip (2h) so the record shows the build-up, but TRADES only inside openWindowHoursBeforeKickoff (45 min) -- after most late scratches and starting lineups.
policy._comment_holdToSettlementMinPrice: 2026-11-02 (user): only positions bought at 0.75+ hold to settlement. Below that, favourites get a resting exit at fair value + the volatility premium (exitVolatilityAlphaLogit), the same as underdogs and Argo-7 totals. Was effectively 0.50, which held every favourite.
policy._comment_stopLoss: OFF (user, 2026-11-01): no stop-loss on moneyline winners, same as Adam-7 since 2026-10-11 -- on the NFL replay the trigger print gapped far below the floor and comebacks cost more than the stops saved.
